kicker: Every preference adds to the picture
heading: The imagination leaderboard
description: Every ranking starts with a real choice.
summary1: Every vote is a meeting of imaginations.
summary2: Wins and ties shape the rankings. “Neither” is counted separately.
rules1: Rankings reflect pairwise voting preferences. Each round counts once, but account-free voting does not guarantee one vote per person. Fewer than 20 matches is marked provisional; this is not a statistical confidence guarantee.
rules2: A model may have multiple submissions. Full original prompts and sampling settings were not recorded. These rankings compare the current artworks, not overall model capability. Legacy votes were not imported. Ties in the ranking calculation are resolved by match count, then model name. Unrated entries have no rank.
internalSummary: Ranked by support rate, then by number of comparisons.
internalRules1: Support rate = (wins + ties × 0.5) ÷ comparisons. Losses and “Neither” earn zero points and still count as comparisons.
internalRules2: Each experiment keeps one selected artwork per model. No login is required; each submission records one vote. Unrated entries have no rank.
